status: Two-message local implementation verified; train and publication evidence follow deployment.
story: Two large messages remain visible throughout playback: Passing work lands first and Keep building during checks. C/D remain applied while A/B are repaired. The same four agent lanes show Next task during checks and following drafts. All three deployments retain approval and default rechecks. Four final drafts remain unsubmitted.

media.codec: H.264 constrained baseline, yuv420p, BT.709, fast-start

visual_iterations.finding: Anonymous agents disappeared when work left. The next batch looked like the old work. Overlap appeared too late.
visual_iterations.change: Keep four numbered agent lanes visible. Give work A-J stable letters. Start E/F at 3.8 seconds during A/B validation. Retain applied changes.

visual_iterations.finding: A second idle interval weakened the continuing-work story.
visual_iterations.change: Capture real G/H edits during E/F validation and show those drafts while checks run.

visual_iterations.finding: The replay crossfade double-exposed task labels. The repair path crowded the check heading.
visual_iterations.change: Switch labels once and fade work cards sequentially. Keep agent identities visible. Move the repair path into the gap.

visual_iterations.finding: The 24-second cycle felt slow and did not name its processing mode.
visual_iterations.change: Keep Batch · default visible. Shorten idle holds with an explicit timing map; export 14 seconds and show the first overlap at 3 seconds. Link captions to the batch/ordered distinction.

visual_iterations.finding: Letter-by-letter narration obscured the batch benefit, and Submitted labels made continuing agents look inactive.
visual_iterations.change: Keep only two large headlines. Hold passing-first through visible repair; label actual new work Next task, distinguish checks from application, group applied receipts by batch and reduce decorative motion. Preserve 14 seconds and recorded work identity.

visual_iterations.finding: The first revised still poster placed its second message too close to the agent heading.
visual_iterations.change: Give the poster two complete large lines, so both messages remain readable without playback.

visual_iterations.finding: Visitors who enter midway through playback can miss a headline that only appears in the opening segment.
visual_iterations.change: Keep both complete messages visible throughout the loop in large type. Emphasize passing work first; turn the next-task message blue when work begins during checks. Match the still poster to the same layout.

visual_iterations.finding: At the beginning of the return motion, cards crossed the section headings.
visual_iterations.change: Move returned cards below the heading band with separate vertical paths, and check the early encoded-frame positions for heading and card overlap.

limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices were not tested. Narrow desktop viewports verify layout only.
The capture scripts agent-authored changes and approvals; it does not launch an AI service. Four displayed agent roles are illustrative.
Two fixture gate barriers make overlap deterministic. Timing is condensed and is not a speed claim.
The animation repeats one recorded window. G-J are drafts, not submitted or validated work.
